column2: On the authority of ʿAbdullāh ibn Busr, who said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah, the laws of Islam have become too many for me, so [tell us of] a comprehensive door to which we can hold fast.”
He said: “Let your tongue remain moist with the remembrance of Allah.” Recorded by Imam Aḥmad with this wording.

“A comprehensive door to which we can hold fast”: so that their performance becomes easy for me, or so that by it I may gain the merit of what I miss of them, other than the obligations. He did not mean to make it suffice in place of the obligations and duties.
The virtue of persevering in the remembrance of Allah the Exalted.
